meta.title: Become a Sitter
meta.description: Join WagStays' verified sitter network. Set your own hours, pets and rates — and earn up to $3,500 a month.

landing.subtitle: Join {city}'s most trusted pet care community. Choose your own hours, the pets you welcome and your rates — all on your terms.

review.text: Our safety team verifies your details within 12 hours.

meet.text: We chat about your love for animals and how you'd handle emergencies.

live.title: Your Profile Goes Live & First Bookings!
live.text: Start getting requests from pet families in your neighbourhood.

rates.q: Can I set my own rates?
rates.a: Absolutely! The amounts in the form are just your area's market averages. Enter any rate you like and update it whenever you want.

paid.a: Earnings are paid by direct deposit the business day after each completed booking — or, if you prefer, in one weekly payout every Tuesday.

wrong.a: Our 24/7 on-call emergency vet line and up to {coverage} in WagShield vet care coverage per booking have your back. You're never on your own.

personal.label: Getting Started
personal.title: Tell Us About You
personal.text: We'll use these details to set up your sitter profile and reach you about your application.
personal.neighbourhoodPlaceholder: Choose where you'll host and walk…

services.title: Services You'll Offer & Pricing
services.text: You can change these anytime. Suggested market rates for your area are filled in.

experience.title: Experience & Pet Preferences
experience.text: Share the expertise that will help pet parents book you with confidence.
experience.yearsQuestion: How many years of pet care experience do you have?
experience.petsQuestion: Which pets will you care for?
experience.petsHint: Pick every kind you're comfortable with — owners can only book you for these.
experience.dogsLocked: Dogs stay selected while you offer Dog Walking.
experience.sizesHint: Tick the options that suit your home and physical strength.

certFirstAid.title: Vet / Pet First Aid & CPR Certificate
certFirstAid.blurb: Know exactly what to do in an emergency

certMedication.title: Oral & Liquid Medication
certMedication.blurb: For pets on a regular medication routine

certBehaviour.title: Behaviour / Reactive Dog Training
certBehaviour.blurb: Working with anxious or reactive pets

home.title: Home & Living Environment
home.text: For boarding and day care especially, the details of your home matter a lot to pet parents.

criteria.ownPets: I have my own friendly pet(s)

photos.title: Photos of Your Home & Resting Areas
photos.hint: Add at least 3 clear photos — it boosts your approval rate by 65%.
photos.skipped: Some files were skipped — use PNG or JPG images up to 10 MB.

bio.title: Introduce Yourself (Bio)
bio.text: Pet parents read this part of your profile first. The warmer and more detailed it is, the faster you'll land your first booking.
bio.placeholder: e.g. Hi! I grew up with cats and dogs and have been caring for my neighbours' pets for six years. I have a calm, fully vaccinated tabby at home, I send photo and video updates every day, and I'm careful with special diets and medication routines…
bio.great: Great bio — pet parents will love it!
bio.tip: Tip: Mention how often you can walk each day, your nearest emergency vet and how much time you can give pets during the day — it doubles your approval speed.

verification.title: Verification & Safety Declaration
verification.text: To keep the WagStays community 100% safe, every sitter applicant goes through ID and background screening.
verification.idDescription: Encrypted with 256-bit SSL and handled under PIPEDA
verification.vscDescription: Issued by your local police service within the last 6 months
verification.agreeTerms: I have read and agree to the WagStays <agreement>Sitter Service Agreement</agreement> and <standards>Pet Safety Standards</standards>.
verification.agreeAccuracy: I confirm that all the experience and home details I've provided are complete and accurate, and I agree to an in-home check if required.

journey.title: Your Approval Journey
journey.subtitle: Become an official WagStays Badge Sitter in 4 steps

step1.title: 1. Document & Security Review
step1.text: Our team is carefully reviewing your government ID, Police Vulnerable Sector Check and proof of address, in line with PIPEDA.

step2.title: 2. 15-Minute Online Meet & Greet
step2.text: Have a short, friendly Google Meet chat with our WagStays community coordinator and ask anything you're curious about.

step3.title: 3. WagStays Badge & Profile Activation
step3.text: Right after your Meet & Greet, your profile goes live for pet parents in {hood} and nearby, and you can start accepting bookings.

step4.title: 4. Welcome Kit & First Booking Support
step4.text: We'll ship a WagStays reflective walking leash, a pet first aid handbook, a treat pouch and an emergency info card right to your door.
